verdict.rationale: LibreChat's beta Agent Management API documents authenticating machine clients through deployment-bound OIDC identities, which is a first-party way to give programmatic clients credentials for agent operations. Nothing shows those credentials can be scoped or restricted to least privilege, and the per-role config overrides are an adjacent control, not credential scoping. missing for 10: documented scoped/least-privilege permissions on issued credentials, a user-facing flow for issuing per-agent API keys or tokens, non-beta status, independent or hands-on corroboration.
